inputs.sequence_prompt:
One uninterrupted fifteen-second live-action shot in the Jidoor opera backstage gantry. The adult man Locke has the exact face, blue bandana, cream embroidered shirt, short dark jacket, blue trousers and tan boots from <Picture 1>. The physical purple octopus Ultros has the exact mantle, eyes, mouth and thick suckered arms from <Picture 2>. These pictures define appearance only.
Locke stands screen left beside a solid stair landing. Ultros rests screen right with its mantle and several arms firmly supported on the timber deck. A grey iron theater counterweight lies horizontally in a deep cradle at the BACK of the gantry, secured with two thick ropes. The counterweight remains stationary and intact throughout this shot.
At the FRONT of the gantry, clearly separated from that counterweight by an open strip of floor, there is one narrow pale wooden crossbar at Locke's waist height. The crossbar is plain unfinished timber, with continuous visible wood grain and square ends. It connects two stout wooden posts. This wooden crossbar is the only object that receives the strike. Its entire length, both ends, and the empty space behind it are clearly visible before and during contact. The iron counterweight stays behind the action and outside the striking arm's path.
One fixed wide camera looks slightly downward from the audience side, above rail height. It shows both full bodies, both boots, the crossbar and stair landing without a foreground rail hiding the contact. Constant diffuse warm work light, matte surfaces, natural shadows, stable exposure.
Seconds zero to five: Locke plants both boots, leans forward and puts his right hand on the LEFT END of the wooden crossbar. He watches Ultros. Ultros slowly draws one front arm back above the RIGHT END of that same crossbar, away from Locke's hand. Its other arms remain planted.
Seconds five to ten: Ultros brings that arm straight down ONCE onto the exposed RIGHT END of the pale wooden crossbar. The arm visibly touches the wood before it bends and cracks at that exact contact point. One short wooden end snaps downward and falls directly onto the deck underneath. The broken stump remains fixed to its wooden post. The rest of the crossbar remains visible. Locke flinches after contact, withdraws his hand and catches the separate solid stair rail with his left hand. Only this wooden crossbar breaks; all metal remains untouched and intact.
Seconds ten to fifteen: Locke puts his right boot onto the solid stair landing and shifts his weight away from the broken bar. Ultros lowers the striking arm to the deck, then extends its tip along the boards toward Locke's ankle. Locke notices this threat and tightens his grip on the stair rail. End before any fall. Grounded weight, one clear impact and a restrained human recoil. Location sound only: boots, breathing, one soft heavy slap on timber followed by a dry wood crack, the short piece landing on the floor, distant muffled audience. Silent mouths.
